headline: From Quarry to Countertop: Tracing the Origins of Natural Stone in Architecture
context: For some time now, it has become common for us to ask where what we consume comes from . We check labels, look for local producers, and investigate supply chains in an attempt to understand the impact of our habits—on our own health and on the planet.
